page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top right. No notes in the margins. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.l: MS. Alexand. posuimus, sine ulla mutatione
præter accentuum appositionem (nisi ma-
nifestus erat librarii error) ut in ipso MS.
reperiuntur, licet quædam sint illius sæculi
propria, quæ a Grammaticorum nostrorum
regulis discrepant, & a nasutulis quibusdam
fortasse inter errata Typogr. reponentur: ut
cum αι scribunt pro (ε) ut παιδίον pro πεδίον
[?], ἀρεστὸν pro ἀρεσὸν [?]: et e contra (ε) pro αι, ut φύλαξε
pro φύλαξαι; sic (ε) simplex pro ει
diphthongo ponitur, ut λέιψει pro λείψει [?],
μ pro ν, ut ἐμμένω pro ἐν μένω [?], μ sæpe interponitur
præsertim in descendentibus a λαμβάνω,
ut λέμψομαι pro λείψομαι [?], υ duplex pro sim-
plici, in verbis a βαίνω, ut διαζευγνύεις pro
διαζευγνύεις [?], aliaque ejusmodi, quæ quia summæ
antiquitatis indicia sunt, et non ex Scribæ
errore fortuito orta, sed constanter per totum
librum reperta et sæculi illius in pronunciando
et scribendo modum indicant, religio nobis
erat mutare.
68. Quod ad Latinas.
70 Versiones at-
tinet, licet multæ essent ut testatur Augustinus,
nec earum ulla parem cum Græca
authoritatem unquam habuerit, una tamen
erat cæteris celebrior quæ ab Augustino
Itala, à Hieronymo Vulgata, à Greg.
Vetus dicebatur, quamque Hieronym. ipse
ad Græcam quæ in Hexaplis sincera erat

page.notes: The "70" inside the first line of the second paragraph appears to be a printed page number or a stray marker in the text; I have kept it as printed but it is doubtful. The Greek readings are uncertain at several points, marked [?]. The bottom "castigavit," at the right is treated as a catchword. The heading "68. Quod ad Latinas." is marked as a level 2 heading, which is doubtful: it may be a numbered paragraph and not a heading. The page number "79" is uncertain because the final digit is printed in a superscript style.
